description.value: Louise's Kitchen is a Smithers institution of more than two decades, blending Ukrainian heritage dishes—perogies, cabbage rolls, garlic sausage—with vibrant Latin-inspired plates like Peruvian saltado and ceviche, alongside classic Canadian breakfasts. The restaurant uses fresh, locally sourced ingredients and maintains a warm, community-focused atmosphere. For touring cyclists riding through the Bulkley Valley, it offers substantial, made-from-scratch meals ranging from hearty breakfast skillets to full dinners.
